name: PENELOPE ISLES + SILENTIDE
description: This is a concert featuring PENELOPE ISLES and SILENTIDE. The event takes place at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto.
longDescription:
PENELOPE ISLES and SILENTIDE are performing a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event is scheduled for November 5, 2026, starting at 10:00 PM.

The concert has an estimated duration of 60 minutes. Tickets are priced at 15€ for general admission.

The venue, Radioclube Agramonte, is located at Rua João Martins Branco 180, 4150-430 Porto. The event is open to individuals aged 16 and over.
